description: List your workspace's integrations (Salesforce and Datadog): whether each is offered to the workspace and, when it is, its state: whether Salesforce is connected, how many records are linked and the last sync; how many Datadog key pairs are saved and the last telemetry delivery. Never a key or token. Needs a Last Price credential with the integrations:read scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.
name: list_integrations
